title: When doubt keeps fogging the path in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind keeps second-guessing what it once knew clearly enough to begin. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru answers doubt by clarifying what is worth trusting, keeping, and repeating. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Stop circling and let Guru's word take residence. Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once.
actionPrompt: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
